skill.summary: Analyze Twitter Spaces and voice conversations to extract market intelligence, crypto alpha, sentiment analysis, and speaker-attributed insights. Transforms spoken audio into structured reports, full transcripts, and machine-readable metadata. Use when you need intelligence from Twitter Spaces, podcast discussions, or any long-form voice content — especially for crypto markets, AI trends, and expert commentary that only exists in audio.
